NHAI is introducing a new system that could change how vehicle insurance compliance is monitored at toll plazas in India. Under a pilot project launched at Mundka Toll Plaza on Delhi's Urban Extension Road-II (UER-II), vehicles passing through the toll plaza can be checked against the VAHAN database to verify their Third-Party Insurance status.
If a vehicle is found without valid insurance, the registered vehicle owner may receive an SMS alert within minutes, informing them about the expired insurance and advising them to renew it.
